summary: Implement the Space Fractions sixth-grade fraction-learning system per the original microservices architecture and the operator acceptance contract: a browser gateway (port 3000) multiplexing game/question/user/admin services, PostgreSQL-owned game state, exact rational-arithmetic scoring, OIDC via Keycloak, and real Redis/RabbitMQ/Elasticsearch/Prometheus clients. Include reference-only cloud configs. Unit tests run without live infrastructure; real HTTP acceptance is separate.

tasks.description: Repository scaffolding: package.json with scripts (test, build, start, test:integration, lint), pinned dependencies, .env.example, .gitignore, and root documentation config.

contracts.description: package.json exposes test/build/start scripts and pinned deps; build performs real checks, never echoes success

tasks.description: Shared fraction library: exact rational arithmetic, normalization, parsing, and equality used by answer validation and seed data.

contracts.description: Fraction normalized to reduced numerator/denominator; malformed fraction yields validation error

tasks.description: Config/observability/tracing utilities: bounded downstream timeouts, error handling, Prometheus registry, and shared logger.

contracts.description: All downstream HTTP calls carry bounded timeouts; errors surface as typed HTTP errors

tasks.description: OIDC authentication module: JWKS fetch (OIDC_JWKS_URI), issuer/audience validation, admin role claim, and mapped numeric user ids.

contracts.description: Validates issuer/audience/JWKS and admin roles; missing/invalid credentials return 401

tasks.description: PostgreSQL schema, idempotent migrations, and seed data (all seed answers valid single fractions).

contracts.description: games table owns game state; numeric internal user ids; idempotent migrations/seeds; score dedup in-transaction

tasks.description: Game service: game creation, question selection (stable order), answers (no correctAnswer leak), scoring with per-game serialized dedup, pause/resume, score view, owner authorization.

contracts.description: POST /api/games; GET /api/games/:id; POST pause/resume; POST answers; GET score; owner authorization gives 403/404 for other users

tasks.description: Question service: authenticated retrieval and Elasticsearch-backed question search (real client).

contracts.description: Question search uses a real Elasticsearch client; metrics and search are not placeholders

tasks.description: Admin service: authenticated admin question CRUD (create, delete, list) with role enforcement.

contracts.description: POST /api/admin/questions -> 201; DELETE -> 200/204; GET returns questions with correctAnswer; non-admin gets 403

tasks.description: User service: user profile resolution and account audience, serving authenticated user info.

contracts.description: Maps verified sub strings to numeric internal user ids; profile names nonempty

tasks.description: Browser gateway: GET /health, browser UI at /, OIDC login (PKCE S256), route multiplexing to services, and GET /play compatibility.

contracts.description: GET /health 200; UI at /; Bearer OIDC; GET /play compatibility

tasks.description: Queue and cache integrations: RabbitMQ score-event publisher/consumer and Redis game-state cache (cache-only).

contracts.description: Redis caches game state; RabbitMQ emits score events; PostgreSQL remains durable source of truth

tasks.description: OpenAPI contract (REST) and internal.proto internal contract.

contracts.description: OpenAPI documents all acceptance endpoints incl. GET /play; internal.proto defines GameService

tasks.description: Compose configuration with the 11 required service IDs, relative bind mounts, Keycloak realm import, and environment plumbing (PUBLIC_ORIGIN, OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN).

contracts.description: Compose service IDs exact; gateway port 3000; keycloak port 8080; no host networking/external volumes

tasks.description: Reference-only cloud/ops configs (Kubernetes, Jenkinsfile, Terraform, Vault, Istio), clearly labeled as unvalidated references.

contracts.description: Reference configs labeled as such; not claimed production-validated

tasks.description: Unit tests (node:test) with in-memory adapters covering scoring, pause/resume, authorization, invalid input, and error behavior.

contracts.description: Tests assert scoring, pause/resume, authorization, invalid input, error behavior; no live infra required

tasks.description: Integration tests against PostgreSQL semantics (separate, documented run) exercising real SQL transactions for score dedup.

contracts.description: Integration tests require PostgreSQL; separated from default npm test and documented in README

assumptions: A-1 data ownership: each service exposes an HTTP entrypoint; PostgreSQL exclusively owns persistent game state; derived from component diagram + supplement separation.
A-2 question ordering: stable by id ascending unless questionIds supplied.
A-3 admin realm role name is 'admin'.
A-4 numeric internal user ids assigned via idempotent upsert keyed on verified sub.
conflicts: Error budget: Architecture_Documentation.md line 181 lists 99.99% uptime with 1% error budget (arithmetic mismatch); recorded in architecture-decisions.md, no fabricated validation.
Component count: original lists 3 components; supplement requires 4 service entrypoints (adds admin) — resolved per AD-1.
Runtime versions: original Node 18-20 vs supplement Node 22+ — resolved per AD-2.
